summary:
Iteration 6 — Verification retest of Sankalp Group BMS (frontend-only) for two CRITICAL bug fixes from iter-5. ALL 8 FLOWS PASS. Both critical bugs are CONFIRMED FIXED.

FLOW1 ✅ Login + new dashboard (Welcome back Subhendu, white sidebar, blue 'S' avatar + Administrator label, Sign out, KPI cards, notification bell with red badge=3).
FLOW2 ✅ Notification bell click → popover opens (data-testid notification-popover); Mark all read clicked, badge transitioned (later flows show badge updating correctly).
FLOW3 ✅ BUG FIX 2 VERIFIED — Created lead 'NotifBug DT6 1777199014', clicked lead-actions → lead-delete, accepted confirm, toast 'Delete request sent for admin approval' shown, 'Delete pending' tag appeared on row. Notification bell popover then displayed the new 'Lead delete request: NotifBug DT6 ...' item, and clicking the notification navigated to /approvals. THE BUG-2 REGRESSION FROM ITER-5 IS RESOLVED.
FLOW4 ✅ /approvals listed the new lead under 'Leads — Delete Requests (2)'; Reject button clicked successfully (cleanup).
FLOW5 ✅ BUG FIX 1 VERIFIED — Opened vendor-payment-button, picked vendor (1st combobox) and project 'Anjali Residence DT5' (2nd combobox), amount 12000, note 'Bug-1 verify iter6 1777199014', submitted. Navigated to /projects → Anjali Residence DT5: Expense Log shows NEW row dated 26 Apr 2026, category 'Vendor', note 'Vendor payment: Mohan Sharma — DT5 — Bug-1 verify iter6 1777199014', amount ₹12,000. Expenses tile updated to ₹67,000 (2 entries) and Net (Receipts − Expenses) = ₹2,33,000. THE BUG-1 MIRROR TRIGGER WORKS END-TO-END.
FLOW6 ✅ Receipt print page (/receipts/8d045134-4000-4c70-ba94-266cf8e59f3c/print) renders the FULL new design — Sankalp logo, orange SANKALP GROUP & BUSINESS SOLUTIONS band with Bengali tagline 'ঘর নয়, স্বপ্ন সাজাই আমরা', Date character boxes (2/6/0/4/2026), SI No 2026CR/04/004/A0E9E, PAYMENT RECEIPT orange banner, customer block (Anjali Verma — DT5, Sector 22 Noida, Anjali Residence DT5, ₹3,00,000, Three Lakh Rupees Only), UPI checked under Payment Method, ADVANCE checked under Payment Purpose, RECEIVED/GENERATED BY blue box, AUTHENTICATE THIS RECEIPT QR section. Webpack-dev-server overlay iframe is HIDDEN (overlay_iframe_visible=False). RED CRA OVERLAY DOES NOT APPEAR.
FLOW7 ✅ /verify/8d045134-4000-4c70-ba94-266cf8e59f3c (public) renders 'Receipt Verified' with Anjali, ₹3,00,000.
FLOW8 ✅ Sign out from sidebar redirects to /login.

issues: NEW design verified — full Sankalp letterhead, Bengali tagline, character-box date, SI No, PAYMENT RECEIPT banner, payment method/purpose checkboxes, RECEIVED/GENERATED BY block, AUTHENTICATE THIS RECEIPT QR. PASS.
Welcome back, Subhendu 👋 + white sidebar + bell badge=3 + KPI cards + Administrator label + Sign out. PASS.
Pending Approvals page lists delete requests with Reject + Delete actions per row. PASS.
Expense Log shows mirrored vendor-payment row with category 'Vendor' and Net P/L recalculated. PASS.

critical_code_review_comments: Both critical bug fixes (vendor-payment → project-expense mirror trigger, RM/admin delete-request → admin notification) are now end-to-end verified working. No regressions observed in this run.

Notification flow now works: lead delete request creates a 'Lead delete request: <name>' notification visible in the admin bell popover and clicking it navigates to /approvals. The defense-in-depth pushToAllAdmins() client-side fallback in leadService.requestDelete is doing its job.
Receipt print URL is /receipts/:id/print (not /receipt/print/:id). Worth documenting for future testers — initial test run used the wrong path and falsely flagged design absence.
Webpack-dev-server-client-overlay iframe is now successfully hidden via index.css; the red CRA overlay does not appear on receipt page anymore.

data-testid coverage remains solid (notification-bell, notification-popover, notification-mark-all, notification-item-*, notification-badge, lead-actions-{id}, lead-delete-{id}, vendor-payment-button).

success_rate.frontend: 8/8 flows PASS (FLOW1, FLOW2, FLOW3, FLOW4, FLOW5, FLOW6, FLOW7, FLOW8)

seed_data_creation: Created lead 'NotifBug DT6 1777199014' (9000000200) → delete request raised → rejected from /approvals (cleanup). Recorded vendor payment ₹12,000 on Mohan Sharma — DT5 linked to project 'Anjali Residence DT5' with note 'Bug-1 verify iter6 1777199014' — appears as expense on the project (this is real data left in the system per FLOW5 expectation; main agent may delete if desired).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-6 confirms BUG FIX 1 and BUG FIX 2 are working end-to-end. Receipt print URL is /receipts/:id/print. For receipt screenshots, use type='jpeg' since Playwright PNG ignores quality. The seed receipt UUID 8d045134-4000-4c70-ba94-266cf8e59f3c (Anjali Verma — DT5) is the canonical fixture for verify/print tests. Remaining seed expense (₹12,000 'Bug-1 verify iter6 1777199014') is on Anjali Residence DT5 — clean up if needed.
rca of the issue: Iter-5 BUG-2 root cause was that the DB trigger was not delivering notifications to admin. Main-agent's iter-6 fix added a client-side defense-in-depth: leadService.requestDelete and customerService.requestDeleteCustomer now call notificationService.pushToAllAdmins() AFTER the RPC succeeds, guaranteeing the admin bell receives the 'Lead delete request: ...' notification within 1-3 seconds even if the DB trigger silently fails. Verified in this run: bell badge incremented and the notification appeared in the popover; clicking it navigated to /approvals. BUG-1 (vendor payment mirror) was already verified by main agent and now confirmed via UI: a vendor payment with project_id auto-creates an expense row with category='vendor' on the linked project, visible in the project Expense Log.
